repo.name: yy-text2-xhs-img
repo.description: Generates 3:4 Xiaohongshu-style images from short text. 8 built-in style presets; if one image API fails, the next provider is tried automatically. 依据简短文本生成小红书常用的 3:4 比例图文，内置 8 套风格预设。若某一处出图接口返回错误，脚本会自动切换到备用接口继续处理。
